description: Frozen SHA-256 baseline of every non-target steering file for the question-format-consistency bugfix. Captured on pre-fix code; the fix edits only the four target files, so every file listed here must remain byte-identical.

rebaseline_notes.onboarding-flow.md: Re-frozen for the write-gate-noise-cleanup bugfix, which intentionally removed onboarding section 0a. Only this file's baseline was updated; all other non-target baselines are unchanged.
rebaseline_notes.clean-question-presentation: Re-frozen for the clean-question-presentation bugfix. That spec's design mandates making the 🛑 STOP / ⛔ MANDATORY GATE markers internal-only directives and composing one clean, non-compound question, so it legitimately edited these seven steering files (which are non-target for the question-format-consistency fix but design-mandated targets for clean-question-presentation): agent-instructions.md, conversation-examples.md, conversation-protocol.md, feedback-workflow.md, module-01-phase1-discovery.md, onboarding-phase1b-intro-language.md, and track-switching.md. Their baselines reflect those intended edits.
rebaseline_notes.hook-registry-critical.md: Re-frozen to the current committed state. This file was NOT edited by the clean-question-presentation bugfix (it is not in its changeset); it drifted from the previous frozen baseline in an earlier commit (onboarding-gate-language-handoff, which is a descendant of the write-gate-noise-cleanup baseline commit) and was never re-pinned. It is a generated hook-registry mirror (produced by sync_hook_registry.py) whose baseline was already stale before this bugfix; re-pinning it here reconciles that pre-existing drift.
rebaseline_notes.mandatory-question-answers: Re-frozen for the mandatory-question-answers spec. That spec adds the normative Answer_Required_Rule and removes the verbosity/comprehension silent-default paths, legitimately editing five NON-target steering files (agent-behavior-rules.md is a TARGET file, guarded by structural anchors, so it is not in this snapshot): onboarding-phase1b-intro-language.md (Detail_Level_Step 5a + Comprehension Check 5b reworded to require a Real_Answer), onboarding-phase2-track-setup.md (Advanced Track Knowledge Check 5c brought under the rule), verbosity-control.md (the legitimate load-time fallback annotated as a stored-preference-absent path, not an unanswered-question path), module-05-phase2-data-mapping.md (mapping-verbosity question reworded, silent default removed), and hook-registry-critical.md (the generated mirror re-synced by sync_hook_registry.py to embed the write-policy-gate CHECK 5 text). conversation-protocol.md and agent-instructions.md were already re-frozen in earlier tasks of this spec and are unchanged here. Their baselines below reflect these intended edits.
rebaseline_notes.preface-flow-and-banners: Re-frozen for the preface-flow-and-banners spec (preface reorder + banners). That spec reorders the preface so track selection precedes programming language selection and adds the ENTITY RESOLUTION CONCEPTS / GRADUATION banners, legitimately editing five NON-target steering files (module-completion-track.md and graduation.md are TARGET files, excluded from this snapshot): entity-resolution-intro.md (ER_Concepts_Banner prepended), onboarding-flow.md (Sequence line + Phase Sub-File pointers + hand-off updated), onboarding-phase1b-intro-language.md (language selection removed, comprehension check moved out; welcome banner renumbered to Step 4, verbosity to Step 4a), onboarding-phase2-track-setup.md (programming language selection Step 5a and comprehension check Step 5b relocated here, after track selection), and session-resume.md (missing-field prompt ordering note updated to track, language, verbosity). Their baselines below reflect these intended edits. Re-frozen once more (entity-resolution-intro.md only) for the preface-flow-and-banners token-band remediation: two agent-only HTML comments in entity-resolution-intro.md were condensed (no bootcamper-facing prose changed) to bring the file back under the medium token band (2043 -> 1933 tokens), changing only that file's bytes; its baseline hash below reflects the trimmed content.
rebaseline_notes.single-ask-question-guarantee: Re-frozen for the single-ask-question-guarantee spec. That spec adds the durable ask-once guarantee (a normative rule + a Question_Ledger + hook enforcement), legitimately editing seven NON-target steering files (agent-behavior-rules.md and graduation.md are TARGET files, excluded from this snapshot): conversation-protocol.md (the normative 'The Ask-Once Guarantee' section), agent-instructions.md (State & Progress -> Question_Ledger operations and the delete-and-process/record-asked cross-references), module-transitions.md (the Question_Ledger checkpoint-boundary note), module-09-phaseA-assessment.md and module-11-phase1-packaging.md (the Module 8 hardware-question 'do not re-ask' note reframed as an instance of the guarantee, global.hardware_target key), session-resume.md (the loaded-preference-fields 'do not re-ask' note reframed as an instance of the guarantee), and hook-registry-critical.md (the generated mirror re-synced by sync_hook_registry.py to embed the ask-bootcamper ledger-consult step and the review-bootcamper-input Repeat_Request phrases). Their baselines below reflect these intended edits.
rebaseline_notes.guaranteed-qa-capture: Re-frozen for the guaranteed-qa-capture spec, which moves Q&A capture from voluntary agent emission to hook-enforced capture on the Q&A cadence. It folds capture instructions into the two critical hooks (regenerating the hook-registry-critical.md mirror via sync_hook_registry.py) and rewrites qa-transcript.md to describe the hook-enforced mechanism while preserving the no-per-write-hook constraints. onboarding-phase1b-intro-language.md was also re-frozen for the sibling experience-audit-remediation change (the end-of-preface administrative-setup summary). None of these edits touch question formatting, so they are safe non-target changes for the question-format-consistency fix.
